mechanism: Where a person was diverted under a superior court drug diversion programme under PC 1000.5, or admitted to a deferred entry of judgment programme under PC 1000 or 1000.8, and successfully completed it, the judge may order the arrest records sealed as described in § 851.92, on written or oral motion of any party, or on the court's own motion, with notice to all parties. There is no statewide Judicial Council form; counties publish their own.

venue.statement: The superior court that handled the diversion or deferred entry of judgment. Local practice and local forms govern; there is no statewide form.

units.legalUnit: Explain the route and identify the local form — statewide guidance covering the qualifying disposition and the automatic portions: that the judge may order sealing on written or oral motion of any party or on the court's own motion with notice to all parties, the § 851.92 mechanics that follow an order, and the instruction to ask the county clerk or self-help centre which local form applies. LegalEase does not select the local form.

omissionProof.statement: units[] enumerates every legal unit that the pinned registry entry and the CA state pack record for ca-diversion-seal, and adds no unit either source does not record. Units 1 and 2 are a one-to-one mapping of registry tracks[47].units[0..1], which is also a one-to-one mapping of registry tracks[47].packetSet.components[0..1] (roles process_guidance and primary_filing). Unit 3 is the only remaining source-recorded document obligation not carried by units 1-2: registry tracks[47].rules.feeWaiver and packetSet.participantActionRequired[7] name Judicial Council form FW-001 as a conditional filing. units[] is therefore a superset of the registry's own units[] and never a subset. No fourth unit exists: the remaining entries in packetSet.participantActionRequired (obtain proof of completion, confirm the completion answer, obtain the county forms, complete the signature and date, sign, notarization, pay fee, serve, file) are participant acts against units 1-3 rather than separate legal units, and are carried in participant-instructions.md and in unit 1's guidance component.

profilePassageReferenced.passage: A person arrested but not convicted may seal the arrest record under PC 851.91 — generally as a matter of right unless a pattern of domestic violence/abuse or other exception applies; PC 851.87 shifts the burden to the prosecutor in contested cases. A stronger remedy, PC 851.8, seals AND destroys the records on a finding of factual innocence.
profilePassageReferenced.interpretation: This is the only passage anywhere in the compiled CA profile that mentions a statute appearing in this track's authority spine (§ 851.87), and it appears inside pathway tool-4-arrest-record-sealing, which is the PC 851.91 non-conviction sealing route, not the § 851.90 diversion route. A full-value scan of the profile for "851.90", "851.92", "1000.4", "1001.9", "diversion" and "deferred entry" returned no other hit and no pathway, question, ordered decision rule, waiting-period rule, exclusion rule, or packet-generator entry for this track. The compiled profile therefore records zero legal units for ca-diversion-seal, and the enumeration above cannot be a subset of it.
